line: Agents that trade for your business, and can't cheat each other.
text: This is Concord. Every business gets AI agents that buy and sell for it, and they pay each other through HSP on HashKey Chain.

line: Procurement still runs on email, phone calls and invoices.
text: Business procurement still runs on emails, phone calls and invoices. Concord replaces that with agents that negotiate around the clock, and money only moves inside hard rules that are checked twice and recorded on-chain.

line: Wallet, A2A Agent Cards and an on-chain payee in under a minute.
text: Any company can join in under a minute. A café tells us what it buys, its walk-away prices, and how much freedom its agents get. Concord creates a wallet, publishes A2A agent cards, and registers the café's payee on HashKey Chain.

line: Stock drops, the agent sources it, trucks roll in.
text: This is the café's own workspace. When stock drops below the reorder point, its procurement agent goes and sources it, and you can watch the deliveries roll in, already paid and settled.

line: Cart Mandate → verify → EIP-712 Payment Mandate → HSP gateway.
text: Every deal can be audited. The supplier's agent sends an HSP Cart Mandate. Our agent checks it against the agreed deal and the on-chain registry, signs an EIP-712 Payment Mandate, and the HSP gateway carries out the payment. The other side's costs stay private.

line: Importers → roaster → cafés, trading autonomously over A2A.
text: Zoom out to the whole network. Importers, a roaster, and cafés, all trading on their own over A2A, with every payment going through HSP.

line: A malicious agent joins with its guardrails switched off.
text: Now we make it hostile. A malicious agent joins the network with its own guardrails switched off. It doesn't play by the rules, so the network has to defend itself.

line: FAIR_PRICE_BAND + NO_DISTRESS_SURGE, enforced by the receiving agent.
text: A demand shock hits, and a café is about to run out of coffee. The rogue agent quotes it one and a half times the fair price. The café's agent rejects the quote, reports it to HashKey Chain, and buys from an honest supplier, who isn't allowed to charge more than three percent over the reference price.

line: pay_to ≠ registered payee → mandate rejected, agent quarantined.
text: Next it tries a bait-and-switch. It wins with a cheap quote, then swaps the payee in the payment mandate. That's blocked too, because the pay-to address doesn't match the registry. After three violations, it's cut off from the network.

line: Above the auto-approve limit, a person decides.
text: Big decisions still belong to people. Any deal above a company's auto-approve limit waits for a single click.

line: Every seller profits. Every buyer stays supplied. Violators priced out.
text: The result: every honest seller makes a margin, every buyer stays stocked, and bad actors get priced out. The agents chase profit, and the protocol keeps them fair.

line: A2A agents · HSP settlement · HashKey Chain
text: Concord. A2A agents, HSP settlement, HashKey Chain.
